text: Entry Requirements 1. Graduation from high school or equivalent educational background. Prospective graduates must provide a pre-graduation certificate issued by their school and obtain their high school diploma before enrollment. 2. Non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign passport, in compliance with the relevant regulations of the Chinese Ministry of Education, including the “Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC “, etc. 3. Good physical and mental health, with no criminal record. 4. English language requirements For non-native speakers of English, either TOEFL (iBT, code: 6210) or IELTS score is required. 4.1 TOEFL (iBT, including the Home Edition and Paper Edition): 90 or above; TOEFL Essentials: 10 or above. 4.2 IELTS: 6 or above. Exceptions: You may be exempted from providing any of these exams if your SAT Evidence-Based Reading and Writing score is 650 or above, if both your ACT Reading and English scores are 27 or above, or if you have recently completed at least 4 years of rigorous academic study in any of the following countries: Anguilla, Antigua, Barbuda, Australia, Bahamas, Barbados, Bermuda, British Virgin Islands, Canada (except Quebec), Cayman Islands, Dominica, England, Federated, Northern Ireland, Scotland, Seychelles, Shetland Islands, St. Kitts-Nevis, St. Lucia, St. Vincent and the Grenadines, Trinidad and Tobago, Turks and Caicos Islands, United States (other than Puerto Rico), US Virgin Islands, Wales, and Singapore. (Those in American Schools and British Schools abroad may also be exempted if at least 4 years of rigorous academic study have recently been completed and if test scores meet the above standards.) 5. Test Scores 5.1 China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA), Score with Mathematics is required. Applicants who have not yet taken the CSCA may submit other Test score materials initially (such as SAT /AP/ACT /A-Level/IB (code: N010601)/UEC/UNT/SJTU entrance test/others). Those who pass the university's selection process will receive a pre-admission notice and must supplement their CSCA scores by June 30, 2026. Upon passing the final selection, a formal admission notice will be issued. a. SAT (code: 6563) or ACT (code: 6983) test scores. Scores with writing test scores are preferred. 2025 First-year admitted class test scores of Middle 50th percentile ranges: SAT total score: 1350-1450 SAT Math: 730-790 ACT total score: 30-33 ACT Math: 28-35 b. A-level scores, you need to apply with Math A or above. c. International Baccalaureate (IB), you need to apply with Math HL 5 or above or SL 7 in Math or above. Predicted A-level or IB scores are NOT accepted. d. Students with valid college entrance exam scores, please contact the International Undergraduate Recruitment Office at gc-admissions@sjtu.edu.cn (e.g., Malaysia UEC exam scores, Kazakhstan UNT scores. France National Exam scores, etc.) e. If you don’t have any exam scores mentioned above, you have an option to take the SJTU International Undergraduate Entrance Exam in spring 2026 with other international students. SJTU International Undergraduate Entrance Exam *Applicants for Engineering Cluster program in English must complete application Exam Registration: Applicants should log in to the Study@SJTU online application system to choose the undergraduate English-taught Program, fill in the application form, submit the electronic version of application materials and complete exam. Application Time: February 6, 2026~ March 10, 2026(Beijing Time, GMT+8) Exam Method: Online Exam Time: Scheduled for March 21–22, 2026. Detailed schedule will be notified via email later. Subjects for Test The outline and sample of the Written Test： Math: Outline Sample Physics: Outline Sample English: Outline Listening (The Hand book of the exam is to be announced later.)
